name: @kontextmind/kxm
description: KXM local-first multi-agent orchestration and operator dashboard
author: KontextMind

scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:packages
scripts.test:core: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 1200000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 test/core/*.test.ts
scripts.test:simulations: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 1200000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 test/simulations/*.test.ts
scripts.test:complete: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 2400000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 test/core/*.test.ts test/simulations/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 1200000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 test/core/*.test.ts packages/core/*/tests/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage:core: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 2400000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=91 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=92 --test-coverage-include=plugins/kxm/src/**/*.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/server.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/mcp-server.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/runtime-supervisor.ts --test-coverage-include=packages/core/*/src/**/*.ts test/core/*.test.ts packages/core/*/tests/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage:complete: npm run build && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 2400000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=93 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=93 --test-coverage-include=plugins/kxm/src/**/*.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/server.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/mcp-server.ts --test-coverage-exclude=plugins/kxm/src/runtime-supervisor.ts --test-coverage-include=packages/core/*/src/**/*.ts test/core/*.test.ts test/simulations/*.test.ts packages/core/*/tests/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:docs && npm run check:versions
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run check:generated
scripts.validate:claude: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate plugins/kxm --strict
scripts.validate:ci: npm run test:coverage && npm run check && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.validate:pr: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-bounded.mjs 1200000 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 test/core/artifacts-exist.test.ts test/core/ci-contract.test.ts test/core/envelope.test.ts test/core/envelope-contract.test.ts test/core/protocol.test.ts test/core/repo-root.test.ts test/core/routes-count.test.ts test/core/smoke.test.ts test/core/version-surfaces.test.ts && npm run check:versions && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run validate:ci && npm run validate:claude
